verdict.rationale: Missive documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with user-chosen permissions. The changelog explicitly covers summarizing the inbox, triaging new conversations, and drafting replies, and a REST API with conversations and drafts endpoints offers a second documented route. However, the evidence only describes agents creating drafts, never sending, so the end-to-end flow stops short. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that an external agent can send email via MCP or the API, detailed MCP tool documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
